business_description: Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets consumer electronics, personal computers, tablets, wearables, accessories, and related software and services. Its core franchise is a vertically integrated hardware, software, and services ecosystem anchored by iPhone, with additional products including Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple TV, and subscription, payments, licensing, warranty, advertising, and digital content services. The company sells globally through direct channels, online stores, retail stores, carriers, resellers, and enterprise/education channels.
business_model: Apple monetizes a large global installed base through premium-priced devices, recurring and transaction-based services, software integration, and ecosystem lock-in. Hardware sales are driven by product cycles, replacement demand, channel inventory, carrier promotions, and geographic consumer spending. Services revenue is higher-margin and more recurring, supported by App Store activity, subscriptions, AppleCare, iCloud, payments, advertising, and licensing. The model depends on brand strength, supply-chain scale, proprietary silicon/software, developer participation, and continued user engagement across devices.
